protocol: Three full original-camera sweeps per backend, 1920x1080, VSM on, throttles/autosave off. 120 post-settle rendered frames retained per cell. No per-frame MCP polling.
samplingNote: This campaign used the frozen update-counter verifier with both throttles disabled. Full scope captures are audited for rendererFrameAdvanced. Final production sampler uses finalized renderer identity and history generation.
cutNote: Camera pose request timestamps were recorded, but no exact recorder-frame camera event ID was recorded. Early frames are post-arm/transition observations, not a claimed exact cut frame.
